results.note: Epistola attributed to Auctor incertus (Beda?). No English translation located. Work appears only in Latin in PL vol. 23, cols. 723A-726C.

Canones lunarium decemnovennalium circulorum. No specific English translation found despite searches. Related medieval lunary texts exist in English (e.g., BL Harley MS 2320), but not this particular work.
Cunabula grammaticae artis Donati. No English translation located. While commentaries on Donatus's grammar exist, no specific translation of this pseudo-Bedan work found.
De argumentis lunae. No English translation located despite searches for lunar commentary works.
De arithmeticis numeris. No English translation located. Pseudo-Bedan arithmetic work; related works by Boethius exist in English but not this specific text.
De arithmeticis propositionibus. No English translation located despite searches for medieval arithmetic texts.
De astrolabio. No English translation located. While Chaucer's Treatise on the Astrolabe (ca. 1391) exists, no specific translation of this pseudo-Bedan work found.
De circulis sphaerae et polo. No English translation located. Astronomical work on celestial circles and poles; no medieval or modern English translation found.
De computo. No English translation located. While Bede's De temporum ratione has Faith Wallis's English translation (1999), this separate work does not appear to have an English version.
De constitutione mundi. No English translation located. Work exists in Latin on Wikisource but no English translation identified.
De cyclo Paschali. No English translation located. Work on Easter cycles; related computistical works exist in English but not this specific title.
De divinatione mortis et vitae. No English translation located. Likely distinct from the medieval 'De vita et morte' dialogue (which does have an English translation from 1530).
De divisione numerorum. No English translation located despite searches for medieval number theory texts.
De divisionibus temporum. No English translation located. While related to Bede's computistical works, this specific title has no identified English translation.
De embolismo. No English translation located. Astronomical/mathematical work on the intercalation; no English version found.
De linguis gentium. No English translation located. Work on languages of nations; no medieval or modern English translation identified.
De loquela per gestum digitorum. No English translation located. Work on finger-counting/hand gestures for arithmetic; while described in modern scholarship, no historical English translation found.
De mensura horologii. No English translation located. Work on measuring hourglasses/dials; discussed in scholarship but not translated to English.
De nativitate infantium. No English translation located despite searches for medieval obstetric texts.

De octo partibus orationis. Confusion exists regarding whether this is a pseudo-Bedan commentary on Donatus or a separate work. Middle English translations of Donatus exist (Cambridge St John's College MS), but unclear if this specific PL volume 90 text is covered.
De phlebotomia. No English translation of this specific pseudo-Bedan work located, though medieval English phlebotomy treatises (e.g., Henry of Blois's translation) exist.
De ratione calculi. No English translation located. Work on methods of calculation; no English version identified.
De ratione planetarum et signorum. No English translation located. Work on planetary ratios and zodiacal signs; no medieval or modern English translation found.
De ratione unciarum. No English translation located. Work on the ratios/measures of ounces; no English version identified.
De septem miraculis mundi. No English translation located. Likely spurious work attributed to Bede on the Seven Wonders; no English translation identified despite the work's historical interest.
De signis coeli. No English translation located. Work on celestial signs/zodiac; no medieval or modern English translation found.
De substantiis. No English translation located. Philosophical work on substances; no English version identified.
Elementa philosophiae. No English translation located. Large philosophical compilation (22,805 words); no English version identified despite size.
Ephemeris. No English translation located. Calendar/astronomical work (13,520 words); no English translation identified.

Hisperica famina. Michael W. Herren published 'The Hisperica famina: a new critical edition with English translation and philological commentary' (Pontifical Institute of Medieval Studies, 1974 for vol. 1, 1987 for vol. 2). This is a modern copyrighted translation.

Interpretatio Sibyllinorum verborum. No English translation located. Pseudo-Bedan work on Sibylline prophecies; appears in Latin manuscripts (e.g., Jesus College MS 51, Bodl. MS 132) but no English translation found.
Musica quadrata seu mensurata. No English translation located. Medieval music theory work; no English translation identified.
Musica theorica. No English translation located. Music theory work; no English translation identified despite subject matter.
Ordo planetarum. No English translation located. Work on planetary arrangement; no medieval or modern English translation found.
Pronostica temporum. No English translation located. Work on prognostication/timing; no English version identified.
Proverbia. No English translation located. Large proverb collection (9,215 words); no English translation identified.

Sententiae philosophicae collectae ex Aristotele atque Cicerone. No English translation located. Large philosophical compilation (61,176 words) drawing from Aristotle and Cicero; no English translation found.
Similitudo arcae Noe. No English translation located. Very brief work (70 words) on Noah's Ark analogy; no English translation identified.
Commentarii in Job. No English translation located. Biblical commentary (only 31 words in PL vol. 91); no English translation identified.
Aliquot quaestiones. No English translation located. Latin text available on Wikisource but no English translation identified.
De creatione VI dierum. No English translation located. Work on six days of creation (14,579 words); no English version identified.
De libro Psalmorum. No English translation located. Large psalm commentary (354,844 words); despite size, no English translation identified.
Expositio versus Genesis. No English translation located. Genesis commentary (172 words); no English version identified.
Interpretatio nominum Hebraeorum. No English translation located. While St. Jerome's Hebrew names work (4th century) has medieval versions, no English translation of this pseudo-Bedan work found.
Quaestiones super Deuteronomium. No English translation located. Medieval biblical questions tradition is well-attested, but no English translation of this specific work identified.
